description: Searches public LinkedIn job listings by keyword (field), with optional location, posting date, job type, experience level, work model and company filters, and returns up to 20 listings as the source sends them (job_position, company_name, job_location, job_link and other fields). Public listings only, nothing behind a LinkedIn login. Not for postings from many job sites: use search_jobs. Required: field.

exp_level.description: Experience filter: internship, entry_level, associate, mid_senior_level or director, e.g. "entry_level"; omitted means all levels. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

field.description: Required job title or company keyword, e.g. "Python developer"; no default. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

filter_by_company.description: LinkedIn numeric company ID as a string, copied from a LinkedIn company or jobs URL, e.g. "1441"; omitted means all companies. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

geoid.description: LinkedIn numeric location ID as a string, copied from a LinkedIn jobs URL (geoId=...); default "92000000" (worldwide). No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

job_type.description: Employment filter: temporary, contract, volunteer, full_time or part_time, e.g. "full_time"; omitted means all types. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

location.description: Location text, e.g. "London" or "Berlin, Germany"; omit for worldwide jobs. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

page.description: One-based result page, integer at least 1, e.g. 2; default 1. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

sort_by.description: Posting-date filter: day, week or month, e.g. "week" for the past week; omitted means no date filter. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

work_type.description: Work model: at_work (on site), remote or hybrid, e.g. "remote"; omitted means all models. No option surcharge; 5 credits per successful request.

name: search_linkedin_jobs
title: Search LinkedIn Jobs
